stick_yang_mills_existence_and_mass_gap.question: Yang-Mills existence and mass gap
references: Clay Mathematics Institute, Millennium Prize Problems (2000)
S. Durr et al., Ab initio determination of light hadron masses, Science 322 (2008) 1224
N. Metropolis et al., J. Chem. Phys. 21 (1953) 1087 (the Markov-chain sampling rule)
stick_yang_mills_existence_and_mass_gap.statement: Does a quantum Yang-Mills theory exist on R^4 for any compact simple gauge group, with a mass gap Delta > 0?

ticks.by: Narrow Highway - the Markov-chain reading (lattice QCD), 2026-10-06
ticks.claim: [the mechanism] A Markov chain with transition matrix P converges to a stationary distribution pi with pi*P = pi; if it obeys detailed balance pi_i P_ij = pi_j P_ji it is reversible and pi is its unique limit. For P=[[0.9,0.1],[0.5,0.5]], pi=[5/6,1/6]: the fixed point (pi P)_1 = 5/6*0.9 + 1/6*0.5 = 0.833333 = pi_1 (sealed), and detailed balance holds, pi_1 P_12 = 5/6*0.1 = 0.083333 = 1/12 = pi_2 P_21 (sealed). Markov Chain Monte Carlo builds P so that pi IS a chosen target distribution - the exact mechanism, demonstrated on a chain small enough to seal.

ticks.by: Narrow Highway - the Markov-chain reading (lattice QCD), 2026-10-06
ticks.claim: [lattice QCD - the mass gap by sampling] Lattice gauge theory computes Yang-Mills / QCD non-perturbatively by exactly this method: MCMC samples gauge-field configurations with the Euclidean weight e^{-S} as the chain's stationary distribution (Metropolis 1953; Hybrid Monte Carlo). The simulations exhibit a nonzero MASS GAP - a lightest glueball ~1.5 GeV and linear confinement - and reproduce the light hadron spectrum (the proton mass) to a few percent from first principles (Durr et al., Science 2008). This is overwhelming NUMERICAL EVIDENCE for the mass gap the Millennium problem names; it is evidence, never the rigorous constructive proof the problem demands.

ticks.by: Narrow Highway - the Markov-chain reading (lattice QCD), 2026-10-06
ticks.claim: [the thread] Markov chains are how the strong force is solved where perturbation theory fails: the alpha_s series (sealed on the fine-structure stick via the beta coefficient b0 = 23/3 > 0, asymptotic freedom) is good at high energy but DIVERGES at low energy, where quarks confine. MCMC on the lattice reaches that regime by sampling, not by expanding - the non-perturbative half of the quantum-field-theory picture the four-forces reading opened. Seal the mechanism; the mass gap stays the open problem.
